variants.project_raw_equality: project/identifier groups plus rawbyte equality only, no lexical links
variants.project_normalized_stream_nonempty: project/identifier, rawbyte equality, identical normalized text SHA256 excluding empty normalized streams
variants.project_normalized_stream_with_empty: same but empty normalized text equality included explicitly

rationale: Jaccard1 is normalized token5gram SET equality, not rawbyte equality or ordered normalized-stream equality; controls do not replace original graph
